host_os_session.summary: Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS on Linux 7.0.0-31-generic, x86_64, UEFI boot.
The active desktop session is X11 with Ubuntu GNOME; the X server has two logical screens using GNOME Shell and Openbox window managers.

host_os_session.summary: The execution context did not expose a login-session identifier, so loginctl session fields were unavailable; this does not negate the independently observed X11 session.

cpu_memory_limits.summary: 67,303,972,864 bytes of RAM and 8,589,930,496 bytes of swap were visible; about 40.25 GB RAM was available and about 0.83 GB swap was used at collection time.

graphics.summary: Two NVIDIA GPUs are present and bound to the proprietary nvidia driver: GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER and GeForce RTX 3050 6GB; the active driver reports version 595.84.

display.summary: Logical X screen 0 spans two normal-orientation 3840x2160 outputs side by side at 60 Hz, with DP-0 primary; total geometry is 7680x2160 and work area is 7614x2104 after desktop reservations.
Logical X screen 1 has one normal-orientation 1366x768 HDMI output at 59.96 Hz; its work area is 1366x722 and no primary flag is exposed.

RandR transforms are identity and GNOME text scaling is 1.75, while the GNOME integer scaling key is automatic/default; exact effective per-application scale and desired companion habitat remain unresolved.

storage.summary: The system root volume is ext4 on local non-rotating NVMe storage, with about 703 GB available; no throughput or latency benchmark was run.

webcam.summary: One NexiGo N60 FHD UVC webcam is exposed through uvcvideo as /dev/video0 for video, /dev/video1 for UVC metadata, and /dev/media0; all nodes are readable by the current process.
webcam.source: device-node metadata and v4l2-ctl capability enumeration

webcam.summary: The video node enumerates MJPEG and YUYV. MJPEG offers eight discrete sizes from 320x240 through 1920x1080 at 30, 25, or 15 fps. YUYV offers 320x240 through 800x600 at 30, 25, or 15 fps, 1024x576 at 20, 15, or 10 fps, and 1280x720 at 10 or 5 fps.

Brightness, contrast, saturation, white balance, gain, power-line frequency, sharpness, exposure, pan, tilt, continuous autofocus, and zoom controls are exposed. No current device holder was detected at the inspection instant.
webcam.source: v4l2-ctl control metadata and fuser exit status only

webcam.summary: Field of view, image quality, latency, sustained stability, multi-client behavior, and concurrent camera/audio/render behavior were not observable without capture or a later bounded experiment.

development_tools.summary: Existing core tools include Git 2.43, Bash 5.2, GCC/G++ 13.3, GNU Make 4.3, Python 3.12.3, Node 24.20/npm 11.19, Docker CLI 29.8, FFmpeg 6.1.1, GStreamer 1.24.2, jq 1.7, and ripgrep 15.2.

Relevant installed diagnostics include lspci, nvidia-smi, glxinfo, xrandr, xdpyinfo, xprop, v4l2-ctl, media-ctl, wpctl, pactl, PipeWire tools, ALSA tools, ffmpeg, GStreamer device monitoring, findmnt, lsblk, hdparm, and sensors.

Clang, CMake, Ninja, Rust/Cargo, Java/Javac, Podman, vulkaninfo, vainfo, smartctl, kscreen-doctor, wlr-randr, swaymsg, Hyprland tooling, and gdctl were not available. Tool absence is not a claim that the corresponding hardware or platform capability is absent.

always_on_operations.summary: systemd 255 is PID 1. The system and user managers both report degraded, with 48 system failed units and 20 user failed units at the observation instant; unit identities were not collected to avoid unrelated system data.
always_on_operations.source: systemctl state and failed-unit count only

always_on_operations.summary: NTP is enabled and synchronized; systemd-timesyncd, logind, D-Bus, and the graphical target are active. The clock uses America/New_York with UTC hardware clock.
always_on_operations.source: timedatectl selected fields and systemctl active-state reads

always_on_operations.summary: Kernel suspend states expose freeze and mem, with deep sleep selected. GNOME is configured to take no automatic suspend action on AC after the one-hour idle timeout; actual suspend/resume behavior was not exercised.
always_on_operations.source: /sys/power metadata and gsettings read-only power keys

always_on_operations.summary: CPU frequency control uses amd-pstate-epp with the performance governor. NVIDIA telemetry exposed GPU temperatures, but no kernel thermal zones and no CPU temperature reading were available; sensors exposed only a wireless-adapter temperature.
always_on_operations.source: cpufreq sysfs, nvidia-smi selected fields, thermal sysfs, and sanitized sensors output

always_on_operations.summary: No host battery or UPS telemetry surfaced. Power-loss recovery, reboot persistence, suspend/resume recovery, thermals under load, energy use, and long-running stability remain unqualified.
